other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be a Graduate (awaiting final year results) or a Post Graduate or Research Student.
Applicant must be enrolled in a reputed university or institution in India or abroad.
Preferably studying Law, IT, MBA, Social Sciences or associated subjects.
Interns must furnish a Declaration of Secrecy prior to commencement of the internship.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a stipend of ₹10,000 per month, along with working space, internet facilities, and a certificate upon satisfactory completion.
